subject: SSO/MFA renewal — phased tenant split & pilot schedule
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SSO/MFA renewal — proposed phased tenant split and pilot

Team —

Quick summary: Okta renewal is up in late July. Rather than a straight renewal on our single-tenant purchase, I propose we pursue a phased tenant split (prod/staging) and run a 6-week segmented pilot to validate per-tenant MFA policies + an endpoint posture baseline. The goals are: reduce blast radius for SAML/OIDC changes, measure per-tenant throughput impact, and secure a short-term price concession for the pilot period.

Draft timeline I’m thinking:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope + procurement ask
- Week 1–2: procurement sign-off + contract amendment (pilot terms)
- Week 3–4: pilot deploy (subset of teams, 2 apps)
- Week 5–6: collect telemetry, posture metrics, and finalize license counts

Ask: Marissa — can you run a quick pricing delta for a 2-tenant split with pilot discounts? Vivek — can you compile the posture-evidence list we need to share with Okta & CloudSec (SOC2 snapshot, endpoint agent mapping)? I’ll prepare a mutual action plan to send to procurement and Okta.

I attached a first-pass pilot plan (tenant_split_pilot_plan.pdf) and flagged the fields we should negotiate.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Product Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tenant_split_pilot_plan.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SSO/MFA renewal — proposed phased tenant split and pilot

Diego —

Thanks, this looks actionable. A few notes from procurement/finance lens:
- Pricing ask: I can model three scenarios (lift & shift, tenant split with pilot discount, and full committed renewal). I’ll prioritize the tenant-split + pilot.
- Billing: need clarity on how Okta will invoice for duplicate license blocks during overlap; that’s commonly billed at full rate unless we get a pilot credit.
- POs: procurement wants a short MSA amendment rather than a full new contract to keep things simple.

Can you share which apps/services we plan to move in week 3–4? I want the license model to match app-level SSO (SAML/OIDC) & per-app MFA enforcement.

I’ll draft the pricing delta and target to have it ready by EOD Wed (6/2).

–Marissa
Marissa Cole
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Peter Simmons <peter.simmons@okta.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Anika Rao <anika@cloudsec.co>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SSO/MFA renewal — proposed phased tenant split and pilot

Hi Diego / Marissa —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses:
1) Pricing: attached is a pricing grid with pilot constructs (Okta_pricing_grid_Q2_2027.xlsx). We can offer a 20% pilot credit on incremental licenses for 6 weeks, capped at 500 seats, and a 10% transition credit if you commit to a 12-month renewal at the end.
2) Tenant split: we support a prod/staging split; it’s fairly common. The main operational lift is identity federation re-mapping and session lifetime tuning.
3) Evidence: we’ve added a short checklist for posture proof points. I’ve looped in Anika from CloudSec — they can run the posture mapping and assist with SOC2 artifact collation if you want a single bundle for audit.

If this works, I can produce a formal amendment and DocuSign URL for the pilot terms by EOD Wed.

Regards,
Peter Simmons
Solutions Engineer, Okta

Attachments: Okta_pricing_grid_Q2_2027.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Peter Simmons <peter.simmons@okta.com>, Anika Rao <anika@cloudsec.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SSO/MFA renewal — proposed phased tenant split and pilot

Peter / Anika —

Thanks. Two operational asks before we sign any amendment:
1) Evidence pack: we need a snapshot of SOC2 control mappings relevant to authentication, plus a recent audit log extract showing admin changes for the past 90 days (redacted where appropriate). CloudSec — can you confirm the format you need for endpoint posture telemetry (agent IDs, OS breakdown, last seen)? I’ll prepare the data extractor.
2) Policy parity: during the pilot we need the ability to apply per-tenant policy overrides (e.g., stricter MFA for prod apps) without global policy drift. Can Okta confirm the exact policy objects that will be overridden in the amendment? We want clear rollback instructions.

Procurement note: Marissa — if Okta requires a PO for the pilot, please have procurement ready to issue a short-term PO that references the amendment.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SSO/MFA renewal — proposed phased tenant split and pilot

All —

Good cadence, thank you. Next steps I’ll own:
- Finalize mutual action plan and share by Thu morning with specific app list for the pilot (two services: auth-api and internal-dashboard).
- Marissa: please attach the pricing delta when you send the PO template; if procurement needs the DocuSign link from Peter, loop them in.
- Vivek: I’ll include a boxed list of SOC2 artifacts + exact telemetry export fields for CloudSec to validate.
- Peter/Okta: please produce the amendment + DocuSign link (even a draft) so procurement can fast-track the PO.

I’ve attached a clean pilot plan and a checklist for the posture artifacts (SOC2_snapshot_2027-05.zip). If anyone has objections to the two-app scope, raise them by EOD Thu. Otherwise we’ll move to procurement and Okta signature.

Cheers,
Diego
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: tenant_split_pilot_plan.pdf, SOC2_snapshot_2027-05.zip
